## Input data

New data since WGHANSA 2023 Nov:

+ PELGAS 2024
+ BIOMAN 2024
+ JUVENA 2025

+ weights at age

+ Updated catch 2023
    - France: no length sampling –> same age structure as AZTI catches in 8abd

## Input data

+ Preliminary catch 1st semester 2024 (total and age 1):
 - Spanish catches preliminary (based on sales)
 - French catches in 1st sem same age structure as Basque catches in June

+ Preliminary total catch 2nd semester 2024 under the assumption that:
    - France and Spain: Nov-Dec catches are XX% of the total catch (average 2010-2023), i.e. Nov-Dec XX tonnes.


+ Preliminary total catch Jan-Oct 2024: 24884 tonnes (XX Fr,  XX Sp from which only XX landed in the Basque Country)
